title: meta.spec
description: What a model should do, decided by a human before any code is written (README section 3, Stage A). Every model under models/marts/ needs one.

grain.description: must say what each row represents, in one sentence; it is the most important definition of the model

primary_key.description: must list the columns that together identify a row uniquely

tier.description: must be "critical" or "standard"; critical means the model feeds business decisions, financial reports or executive dashboards

additionalProperties.description: must define the metric in natural language, so the diff can compare its value between production and the new version

metrics.description: must be a mapping of metric name to natural language definition; write {} when the model calculates none

items.description: must describe the expected result of a special case, not the implementation of it

known_edges.description: must list the special cases the Author already knows about, each of which becomes a unit test; write [] when there are none

sensitive_columns.description: must list the columns that contain personal data, so Control 2 masking applies to them; write [] when there are none

reconciliation_query.description: must be a path like analyses/reconciliation_<model>.sql, the query that compares the model with a source of truth outside the warehouse

reconciliation_tolerance.description: must be a percentage written with a percent sign, such as "0.1%": the largest difference from the source of truth that still passes

external_validation.description: must be a concrete number from outside the warehouse that anchors the model, because the spec itself can be wrong

then.description: a critical model also declares reconciliation_query, reconciliation_tolerance and external_validation
